messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: metering-delta detected for customer 'Orchard Corp' (tenant_id=orch-981). Source: dedicated-vpc-pool-7. Delta=+2.3M tokens over 30m vs expected. Severity: P2. Paging oncall: ryan (oncall).
ryan (oncall): got it, I'll take. any initial customer impact?
jordan (cs): Orchard reported a surprise spike in invoice preview earlier, asked why billing jumped. They're concerned but not yet escalated externally.
aly (sre): I'm pulling metering logs now. tagging maya for ingestion pipeline question.
maya (eng): on it. quick Q: is Orchard on dedicated pool with multiple replicas? I think yes (dedicated-vpc-pool-7, replicas=3). Potential double-ingest on failover?
aly (sre): running query on metering DB for tenant orch-981: ```sql
SELECT ingestion_id, recorded_at, token_count, source_id
FROM metering.records
WHERE tenant_id='orch-981' AND recorded_at >= now() - interval '1 hour'
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
aly (sre): returning suspicious duplicates: same ingestion_id shows twice with different source_id (pool-7-replica-a, pool-7-replica-b) around 2026-03-14T02:12:xxZ.
maya (eng): that suggests downstream dedupe didn't fire. recently deployed change to the dedupe window for vpc pipelines (PR #2149) — rolling back to confirm.
emma (billing): holding on notifications until we know if counts will be corrected. if this stays we need to create a corrective credit.
ryan (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) isolate Orchard's metering stream to single ingest follower on pool-7; 2) pause aggregator job for orch-981 to prevent double-summing; 3) revert dedupe window if rollout caused regression; 4) run reconciliation and produce corrected invoice preview. anyone object?
maya (eng): starting isolation: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/repl-control/isolate -d '{"pool":"pool-7","tenant":"orch-981","target_replica":"replica-a"}'` -> 202 ACCEPT.
ops-bot: replicate-control: job queued (job_id=jc-7721), estimated 20s.
aly (sre): paused aggregator for orch-981: ```bash
kubectl -n metering scale deploy/aggregator --replicas=0 -l tenant=orch-981
``` -> paused.
jordan (cs): looping in customer: "We're investigating strange billing spike, should have more info in ~1h. No action required from Orchard right now." they appreciate the heads-up. :thumbsup:
emma (billing): got aggregates paused. i'll snapshot current invoice preview and not finalize. also creating a temporary credit hold in billing system (credit_hold=true) so Orch won't be billed incorrectly.
aly (sre): rolled back dedupe window change to prior value (release 2026-03-14T01:50Z). monitoring ingestion stream for 15m.
aly (sre): initial reconciliation run: raw_tokens_count=19,120,454; deduped_tokens_count=9,541,213 -> about ~9.6M overcount (matches alert magnitude).
maya (eng): root cause hypothesis: race during replica failover caused duplicate ingestion events to be accepted because idempotency keys were not consistently propagated. patch ready (ensure ingestion_id canonicalization at ingress). will push hotfix to canary traffic on pool-7.
ryan (oncall): next steps: maya to deploy hotfix to canary, aly to complete full reconciliation and mark corrected counts, emma to prepare customer-facing credit + final invoice delta, jordan to coordinate customer comms. I'll stay on call for the handoff.
maya (eng): deploying hotfix to canary now (canary=pool-7-replica-a). `kubectl -n ingestion set image deploy/ingest-service ingest=ingest:v2.3.7-hotfix`
ops-bot: deploy started. health checks: pending.
aly (sre): reconciliation in progress — running job: `python tools/reconcile_metering.py --tenant orch-981 --window 2h --output /tmp/orch-recon.csv`
aly (sre): partial results attached (snippet):
```
recorded_at,source_id,ingestion_id,raw_tokens,deduped_tokens
2026-03-14T02:12:03Z,pool-7-replica-a,ing-ff12,1024300,512150
2026-03-14T02:12:04Z,pool-7-replica-b,ing-ff12,1024300,0
```
aly (sre): shows same ingestion_id counted twice; dedupe failed on replica-b.
emma (billing): preparing credit: reason="metering double-count detected (Orchard)" amount_estimate="~$X,120". will hold final until recon complete.
jordan (cs): customer message ready (draft): "We detected an internal metering issue impacting your invoice preview. We've paused finalization and are reconciling. Expect update within 2 hours. Apologies for the disruption." want me to send now?\ryan (oncall): hold until recon completes; send if recon >30m.
maya (eng): canary looks healthy, idempotency fix accepted, promoting to pool-7 replicas in controlled rollout.
aly (sre): reconciliation finished. corrected_tokens=9,541,213 (removed duplicates). ingestion pipeline now rejecting duplicate ingestion_id from other replicas.
ryan (oncall): looks like mitigations worked. customer impact: invoice preview inflated but final invoices will be corrected. severity downgrade to P3.
emmashort (billing): (typo?) actually billing display name should be emma (billing) — confirming credit queue updated.
emma (billing): confirmation: credit hold applied, provisional credit created, ticket #BILL-4512.
jordan (cs): sent customer note: they replied thanks and said they'll hold off on escalating. :relieved:
ryan (oncall): handoff to aly for overnight monitoring and postmortem writeup. aly, please own the follow-up and include timeline + code PR (#2154) in postmortem.
aly (sre): taking it. I'll post incident postmortem in #postmortems and assign follow-ups. ETA for writeup 24h.
ryan (oncall): thanks team. close loop once postmortem and billing correction are complete. :white_check_mark:
